title: Overview
description: Provides a high-level introduction to Tokio, its core components, and its philosophy for building fast, reliable, and scalable asynchronous applications.

title: Getting Started
description: A step-by-step guide to setting up a new Tokio project, including installation and a simple, working TCP echo server example.

title: Core Concepts
description: Explores the fundamental concepts and components that make up the Tokio runtime, providing a solid foundation for advanced usage.

title: Tasks & Scheduling
description: Covers how to work with asynchronous tasks, including spawning, cancellation, yielding, and handling blocking operations.

title: Asynchronous I/O
description: Details Tokio's non-blocking I/O primitives for networking, filesystem operations, and inter-process communication.

title: Synchronization
description: Explains the various synchronization primitives like channels (mpsc, oneshot, watch, broadcast), mutexes, and semaphores for managing shared state between tasks.

title: Timers
description: Describes utilities for tracking time and scheduling work, including sleeps, intervals, and timeouts.

title: The Runtime
description: Details the Tokio runtime itself, including its schedulers, configuration options, and how it executes asynchronous code.

title: API Reference
description: A comprehensive, searchable reference for all public APIs provided by the Tokio crate, organized by module.

title: I/O
description: API documentation for asynchronous I/O traits, helpers, and type definitions.

title: Networking
description: API documentation for TCP, UDP, and Unix socket types for network communication.

title: Synchronization Primitives
description: API documentation for tasks synchronization primitives, including channels, mutexes, and semaphores.

title: Tasks
description: API documentation for managing asynchronous tasks, including spawning and task-local storage.

title: Time
description: API documentation for utilities that track time, including sleeps, intervals, and timeouts.

title: Filesystem
description: API documentation for asynchronous file and filesystem manipulation operations.

title: Processes
description: API documentation for asynchronous process management.

title: Signals
description: API documentation for asynchronous signal handling.

title: Runtime
description: API documentation for the Tokio runtime, including builders and handles for manual configuration.

title: Examples
description: Provides a collection of working code examples that demonstrate various Tokio features and use cases.

title: Changelog
description: A detailed record of all notable changes made to the Tokio library in each version.
